YOUTH SERVICE II, INTERACT
CAREER COUNSELING - ORIENTATION
At : *SANE GURUJI VIDYA MANDIR + SMGS ENGLISH HIGH SCHOOL*
Date : *3rd September, 2026**
Beneficiaries : * *100 + Students of Class 10*
Speaker :
**HIMANSHU DAVE*
*(VITAMELIORA LLP)*
A very informative session conducted by Mr Himanshu Dave for Class 10 Students.
He explained in detail the career options available to students after Grade 10 - both concentional and non- concentional. He elaborated on various mandatory entrance exams for different vocational and professional cources, subjects and streams to be selected for the same and optional cources available.
The students asked various questions to clear their doubts and queries.
